_doc: Scenes (T-0043): short text moments shown in a popup. pages: the text of each page, with {actor}, {target}, {place} and pronoun forms {actor.they}, {actor.them}, {actor.their}, {actor.themself} (same for target) filled in by the view. adult must be false in the core game. Triggered by an interaction's presentation (see data/interactions). Scenes never change the game.

pages: The radiator ticks. Somewhere upstairs, someone is arguing about money, then a door slams and it's quiet.
{actor} wakes up in the new flat. Through the window the first tram rattles past on the Hauptstraße. Day two in the Altstadt.
The Anker is loud tonight. Someone has put the same song on the jukebox three times, and nobody minds.
{actor} leans on the bar a little longer than planned. The barman refills {actor.their} glass without asking.
Behind the bar, past the crates of empties, there's a low door with a padlock that looks newer than everything else in the Anker.
A thin line of light shows under it. Somebody is down there, and {actor} decides not to knock. Not tonight.
The Altmarkt is empty. The fountain gurgles, and the coins at the bottom catch the light of the last tram.
{actor} rolls up a sleeve. The water is colder than expected.
Café Wolke smells of burnt milk and cinnamon. Outside, the tram bell rings twice.
For a moment {actor} forgets about everything else.
